entities.name: César Chávez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: American labor leader (1927-1993) who co-founded the National Farm Workers Association (later United Farm Workers) and organized migrant agricultural workers in California. His nonviolent tactics — boycotts, fasts, marches — improved wages and working conditions for farmworkers and made him a hero of the American labor and Latino civil rights movements.
